meta.name: mom-test
meta.description: Talk to customers without leading them using Mom Test rules: discuss their life not your idea, ask about specifics in the past, and talk less. Use when the user mentions "customer interviews", "validate my idea", "users say they want it but dont buy", "leading questions", "The Mom Test", "customer feedback bias", or "interview script". Also trigger when preparing user-research questions, interpreting ambiguous feedback, or designing customer-discovery that avoids false positives. Covers commitment and advancement, avoiding compliments, and extracting signal from noise. For product-market fit, see jobs-to-be-done. For rapid prototype testing, see design-sprint.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Mom Test 法则进行无偏见的客户访谈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常做客户访谈却总得到虚假肯定信号
copy.tagline_en: Conduct unbiased customer interviews using Mom Test rules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get false positive signals from customer interviews

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照《Mom Test》规则引导你进行客户访谈：讨论客户的生活而非你的想法，询问过去的具体行为而非假设，并让你少说多听。每次对话后，Claude 会给出 1-7 分的评分，指出失败项并提供改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“客户访谈”、“验证想法”、“引导性问题”等关键词，或准备用户研究问题、解读模糊反馈、设计避免假阳性的客户发现时触发。

say.text: 帮我准备一个客户访谈提纲，验证我的新想法。
say.note: Claude 会生成符合 Mom Test 规则的问题。

say.text: 分析这段客户反馈，告诉我哪些是事实、哪些是恭维。
say.note: Claude 会提取信号并评分。

say.text: 我刚刚做完一个访谈，帮我评分并指出改进点。
say.note: Claude 会给出 1-7 分及具体建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through customer interviews using Mom Test rules: discuss their life not your idea, ask about past specifics, and talk less. It scores each conversation out of 7, names failing rows, and gives fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "customer interviews", "validate my idea", "leading questions", etc., or when preparing user-research questions, interpreting ambiguous feedback, or designing customer-discovery to avoid false positives.

say_en.text: Help me prepare a customer interview script to validate my new idea.
say_en.note: Claude generates Mom Test compliant questions.

say_en.text: Analyze this customer feedback and tell me what's fact vs compliment.
say_en.note: Claude extracts signal and scores it.

say_en.text: I just finished an interview, please score it and suggest improvements.
say_en.note: Claude gives a score out of 7 and specific fixes.
